text: Boris Karloff introduces three tales. A French call girl alone in her basement flat receives [threatening calls from the pimp she sent to prison|wants|revenge for a wrong]. In nineteenth-century Serbia, a farming family waits for old Gorca to come back from hunting a wurdalak, a vampire that [preys on the people it loved|threat|blood drinkers], and soon a dead child [begs at the door to be let in|rules|it must be let in]. A nurse preparing a body for burial [slips a valuable ring from the corpse|wrong|disturbing the dead] and is haunted at home by its owner.
